Subject: Meridian Health evaluation — success metrics & kickoff plan

Thanks for a productive call earlier. Quick post-call recap and proposed Plan of Action (POA) so we have a concrete starting point for the evaluation. Please review and confirm or flag changes.

Key business objectives (from call)
- Faster triage of incoming patient queries to reduce manual routing by 40%
- Maintain or improve routing accuracy for top-5 intents compared to current workflow
- Ensure PII handling and auditability for clinical QA

Proposed success metrics (first-pass)
- Intent extraction F1 >= 0.92 on a 10k sampled log set (owner: Meridian analytics)
- End-to-end p95 latency <= 300ms for 512-token context (owner: Redwood infra)
- Token cost target: <= $0.002 per 1k model tokens for steady-state inference (owner: Ben / Finance)
- No critical security findings from infra review (owner: Meridian security)

Scope & timeline (suggested)
- Kickoff workshop: week of Oct 26 (30–60m, ops + security + engineering) — propose Oct 26 or Oct 28
- Data ingest & sample exchange: Oct 26–Nov 2 (Meridian provides anonymized sample set)
- Baseline runs & metric collection: Nov 3–Nov 16
- Weekly checkpoints: cadence (30m) each Thu 9:00 PT, first on Oct 28
- Final readout & go/no-go: week of Nov 22 (30–60m)

Owners & immediate next steps
- Ben Carter (AE, Redwood) — coordinate kickoff, HubSpot updates, commercial items
- Monica Patel (Solutions Eng, Redwood) — technical onboarding, infra checklist, runbook
- Aisha Kaur (Meridian) — sample dataset owner, product point of contact
- Tom Reynolds (Meridian) — exec sponsor and decision owner

Attachments included: mutual-action-plan.pdf (mutual action plan), meridian-eval-metric-matrix.xlsx (metrics matrix).

Can you please: 1) confirm kickoff date (Oct 26 or Oct 28), 2) confirm Aisha will lead sample delivery, and 3) identify your security point of contact to include in the kickoff?

Thanks — looking forward to running this with you.

—

Thanks — I’ll own the technical onboarding and run the baseline tests. A few technical clarifications and the runbook we’ll follow (attached: infra-runbook.md):

Technical checklist (pre-kickoff items)
- 1) Sample dataset: CSV or Parquet with columns: message_id, text, timestamp, routing_label, deid_flag. Please confirm export format and a secure share point. (owner: Aisha)
- 2) Network access: a temporary allowlist IP and one service account for SFTP/transfer. Provide expected windows. (owner: Meridian infra)
- 3) Tokenization & length profile: send 1000 representative messages so we can validate context window and batching. (owner: Redwood)
- 4) GDPR/PII: confirm fields that must be removed vs pseudonymized. We'll provide a pseudonymization checklist for the export. (owner: Meridian compliance)

Evaluation plan details
- Test sets:
  - Stability set (5k messages) — sanity and regression checks
  - Challenge set (2k messages) — edge cases for routing and escalation logic
  - Latency bench set (1k long-context messages) — worst-case p95 estimate
- Success gates:
  - Gate 1 (data readiness): sample delivered and ingest verified
  - Gate 2 (baseline quality): intent F1 >= 0.90 initially; target 0.92 by readout
  - Gate 3 (ops): latency p95 <= 300ms and no critical security flags

Weekly checkpoint agenda (30 min)
- 1) Quick status (5 min)
- 2) Blockers & actions (10 min)
- 3) Recent runs & metrics (10 min)
- 4) Next 7 days plan (5 min)

Proposed final readout deliverables
- Metrics deck (precision/recall by intent), latency/cost summary, live demo of routing flows, and a short ops readiness checklist.

I’ll circulate a short runbook and calendar invites for the proposed cadence. If Oct 26 kickoff works, I’ll schedule for 11:00 PT and include a Zoom link.
